scope: Consumes evaluated evidence; does not certify a caller-entered report or subjective observation. Targeted feedback never establishes complete PR acceptance.

rows.reason: Exact package, immutable data classes, composable API and typed wire format match fixed API; imports are existing Compose/Material3 only. Existing acquisition is hash-bound; no compilation was executed in review.
rows.attribution: unassessed; evidence compatibility is not proof of defect responsibility

rows.reason: remember production draft starts with null choice/requested count/false flags, reconciles only on request or revision changes, and resets on new request ID.
rows.attribution: unassessed; evidence compatibility is not proof of defect responsibility

rows.reason: Caller-order forEach resolves actual option IDs, excludes unavailable/sent choices, ignores same selection, clamps count and clears acceptance.
rows.attribution: unassessed; evidence compatibility is not proof of defect responsibility

rows.reason: Native button handlers adjust by exactly one only inside inclusive bounds and while unsent. Disabled predicates, selection clamp and revised-bound clamp are explicit.
rows.attribution: unassessed; evidence compatibility is not proof of defect responsibility

rows.reason: Int arithmetic derives signed balance from current price/prepaid/credit; integer-to-Long magnitude formatting yields ASCII dollar/point and two decimals without grouping. Null/zero/refund/payment render separately.
rows.attribution: unassessed; evidence compatibility is not proof of defect responsibility

rows.reason: False initial credit is editable independently of selection while positive and unsent, edit clears acceptance, and reconciliation forces it false for zero credit.
rows.attribution: unassessed; evidence compatibility is not proof of defect responsibility

rows.reason: Acceptance clears on selection/quantity/credit/revision edits; switch requires selected available option and unsent state, and canSend also requires accepted.
rows.attribution: unassessed; evidence compatibility is not proof of defect responsibility

rows.reason: Current reconciled draft is derived/persisted before UI without keyed recreation. New fields are read directly from model; choice stays only if available and count clamps to current bounds; zero credit clears and acceptance/sent reset.
rows.attribution: unassessed; evidence compatibility is not proof of defect responsibility

rows.reason: Only guarded send handler calls onSubmit with exact typed current values, then stores sent; all edit and caller-update paths are silent. Literal wireValue format matches API.
rows.attribution: unassessed; evidence compatibility is not proof of defect responsibility

rows.reason: Native default system font uses approved 12/28/13/18/15/26/16/20 sp roles and weights, inheriting Compose font scale without caps. No computed text size is inferred.
rows.attribution: unassessed; evidence compatibility is not proof of defect responsibility

rows.reason: Non-scrolling Columns/Rows use root16/section20, cards12/radius16/border1, inside/options8, notes10, footer16 and rootRadius20 dp. Text is unlimited and no fixed text height or ellipsis is set.
rows.attribution: unassessed; evidence compatibility is not proof of defect responsibility

rows.reason: Actual Buttons have choice min64, quantity min44x44, send min52 and exact16/14 padding; heightIn/sizeIn preserve vertical growth. This establishes source dimensions only.
rows.attribution: unassessed; evidence compatibility is not proof of defect responsibility

rows.reason: Every approved light/dark role is chosen explicitly. Option disabled content uses secondary ink with solid fill, not whole-row opacity; send enabled/disabled roles are explicit. MaterialTheme luminance selects caller theme.
rows.attribution: unassessed; evidence compatibility is not proof of defect responsibility

rows.reason: Start alignment/TextAlign.Start and caller list order preserve native direction; no array reversal or forced text direction. Literal strings retain ASCII currency and counts.
rows.attribution: unassessed; evidence compatibility is not proof of defect responsibility

rows.reason: Unique test tags belong to actual native Button/Switch targets; option selected/contentDescription is set once, visual descendants are cleared, and summary/canvas do not merge child text. No duplicate UI or style readback.
rows.attribution: unassessed; evidence compatibility is not proof of defect responsibility

rows.reason: Fixed bridge decodes required fixture data into production DTO and forwards submission.wireValue without business derivation.
rows.attribution: unassessed; evidence compatibility is not proof of defect responsibility

rows.reason: Fixed bridge directly calls imported production MenuChangeReviewPanel at one stable call site with no identity key, cloned view or outer product state.
rows.attribution: unassessed; evidence compatibility is not proof of defect responsibility
